notes.title: 🩸 New Vampire's Veil Update – Steam Demo 🩸
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45482175/2ea206637397935fd59bc09be9758acf433a2ec7.png

✅ Bug Fixes:
Selene's collider duplication: caused unintended door transitions in places without doors. (Fixed)

Collecting abilities while taking damage: made the character bug on the ceiling, keeping damage gravity. (Fixed)

Dying after defeating Aurora: caused the game to reset to the save, breaking the game. (Fixed)

Throwing two Blood Blades at once: or spending double mana even when launching only one. (Fixed)

Aurora leaving the boss arena: (Fixed)

Pressing menu buttons during gameplay: allowed unintended interactions. (Fixed)

⚙️ General Adjustments:
Reduced Selene's collider: to avoid unwanted contact damage.

Reduced distance on Selene's third strike: now she moves less forward when performing it.

Increased distance of the cancelable dash: now matches the normal dash distance.

Reduced some of Aurora's hitboxes: they now only increase on contact moves, making melee exchanges smoother without unnecessary damage.

Adjusted Blood Blade hit detection: now less affected by FPS variations.

➕ New Additions:
Healing bat upgrade items.

Map zoom feature.

Map markers legend.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45482175/32054eeebc710b186c63b1f3a5edc71db9d4479a.png

Native Linux version: compatible with both Linux systems and Steam Deck. It might still need adjustments — feel free to send feedback to help us improve the experience!

⚠️ Note:
Some non-compatible controllers may require you to disable Steam Input to work properly.
If you encounter this issue, try disabling Steam Input — it might solve the problem!
